meta.title: After award, the event's start and close times are set from its rounds and open rounds are pulled in
gaps: The available read-back fields do not expose the event start time or a distinct event close time, so earliest-round-start and latest-price-round-close equality cannot be asserted.
The available assertion operators cannot compare ending times across rounds or verify that later-closing rounds were pulled to the calculated close time.
the decisive step tests something else than the case's point: No setup recipe creates the separate technical-only event or an event whose rounds are all withdrawn.
No operation withdraws individual rounds, so the all-withdrawn timing case cannot be arranged or verified.
The behavior for a withdrawn event receiving no timing updates cannot be tested with the available setup and read-back fields.
the part about “po” is outside what an API plan on a sourcing event checks

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFP + RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has submitted its technical response; rounds still open.
steps: The buyer enters a surrogate bid of 1 on the vendor's behalf for the invited QA vendor.
The buyer opens an award proposal.
The buyer awards the line to a vendor on the proposal for the invited QA vendor.
The buyer reads the pricing round.
The buyer reads the technical round.
As the buyer, read the event and check that the event carries the award proposal.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: the event carries the award proposal.
